## 题目
Find the matrix \(A\) of the linear transformation \(T(f(t))=f(8t+6)\) from \(P_2\) to \(P_2\) with respect to the standard basis \(\{1,t,t^2\}\).

## 解法
Scalars are real (field unspecified), and this solution uses the matrix method. Compute \(T\) on the standard basis and write each image as a coordinate column vector relative to \(1,t,t^2\):
\[
T(1)=1,\quad T(t)=8t+6,\quad T(t^2)=(8t+6)^2=36+96t+64t^2.
\]
Thus
\[
[T(1)]_{\mathcal B}=\begin{bmatrix}1\\0\\0\end{bmatrix},\quad
[T(t)]_{\mathcal B}=\begin{bmatrix}6\\8\\0\end{bmatrix},\quad
[T(t^2)]_{\mathcal B}=\begin{bmatrix}36\\96\\64\end{bmatrix}.
\]
The matrix \(A\) has these as its columns:
\[
A=\begin{bmatrix}
1&6&36\\
0&8&96\\
0&0&64
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

\[

1&6&36\\
0&8&96\\
0&0&64
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

Let \(p(t)=a+bt+ct^2\), so its coordinate vector is \([a,b,c]^T\). Applying \(A\) gives
\[
A\begin{bmatrix}a\\b\\c\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
a+6b+36c\\
8b+96c\\
64c
\end{bmatrix},
\]
which is exactly the coordinate vector of
\[
p(8t+6)=a+b(8t+6)+c(8t+6)^2
=(a+6b+36c)+(8b+96c)t+64c t^2.
\]
So the entries match.

Find the matrix \(A\) of the linear transformation \(T(f(t))=f(8t+6)\) from \(P_2\) to \(P_2\) with respect to the standard basis \(\left\lbrace 1,t,t^2 \right\rbrace\).

## 解法

\[
T(1)=1,
\]
so
\[
[T(1)]_{\mathcal B}=
\begin{bmatrix}
1\\
0\\
0
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

\[
T(t)=8t+6,
\]
so
\[
[T(t)]_{\mathcal B}=
\begin{bmatrix}
6\\
8\\
0
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

\[
T(t^2)=(8t+6)^2=64t^2+96t+36=36+96t+64t^2,
\]
so
\[
[T(t^2)]_{\mathcal B}=
\begin{bmatrix}
36\\
96\\
64
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

Thus the matrix \(A\) has these coordinate vectors as its columns:

\[
A=
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & 6 & 36\\
0 & 8 & 96\\
0 & 0 & 64
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

## 约定
无（标准基顺序已由题目固定为 \(1,t,t^2\)）。
来源：继承已有解法

## 答案
\[
A=
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & 6 & 36\\
0 & 8 & 96\\
0 & 0 & 64
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

## 可核对结论
- 类型：矩阵
- 结论：1 | 6 | 36 | 0 | 8 | 96 | 0 | 0 | 64
- 约定：按 \(1,t,t^2\) 顺序读列
- 约定来源：继承已有解法

## 检验
Let \(p(t)=a+bt+ct^2\). Then \([p(t)]_{\mathcal B}=[a,b,c]^T\). Applying \(A\) gives

\[
A
\begin{bmatrix}
a\\
b\\
c
\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
a+6b+36c\\
8b+96c\\
64c
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

Meanwhile,

\[
p(8t+6)
=a+b(8t+6)+c(8t+6)^2
=(a+6b+36c)+(8b+96c)t+64c t^2,
\]

which has exactly that coordinate vector. Therefore the matrix entries are correct.
